items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: On the beginning I had the band to start off with breaks, with Kline and breaks

ctx.x: Okay, yeah, we got it. Yeah. So what did you do with that beginning?

On the beginning I had the band to start off with breaks, with Kline and breaks, which is something a little different because usually they have Kline and a trumpet breaks in the middle of the tune, in the middle of the chorus. But I wanted to start the tune off with the tune off with the chorus. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
